author: Porkyyy
body:
Hello everyone, since I recently hit 300 subscribers on YouTube, I've decided to give you guys a shoutout!

If you want to know all the details, refer to this video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8Yx-5jlex5A&feature=youtu.be

Good luck everyone, I wish you all the best!

Hopefully, we can get some more people to join Avicus this way! :D
